changelog:
RS Optimization v1.17.0 — Game Library & Automatic Performance Sessions
• Added Game Library detection and Launch Through RS for nine supported games plus custom executables.
• Added automatic per-game Lite, Balanced, Performance, Competitive and Extreme profiles.
• Added Auto Boost, Auto Restore and local optimized-session history.
• Added favorites and validated game-profile Import / Export.
• Added periodic Health Check, hardware and Windows-update detection, reset-tweak detection and storage warnings.
• Added shareable Before / After PNG benchmark reports.
• Added simplified optimization cards, real DNS ranking, SSD Auto TRIM, BIOS Advisor and Latency Lab.
Validation: release build passed and all 58 functional checks passed.
Detailed changelog: https://github.com/NutzuSefu/rs-config/releases/tag/v1.17.0
